messages:
Nadia Chen: Quick note 11:00am PT all-hands tomorrow. Exec update + two focused items: Data Retention Policy v2 (short brief) and a dry-run Canary for Dedicated Burst. Drop Qs and any customer anecdotes here. Recording + slides after.
Omar Ruiz: will the Dedicated Burst canary affect autoscaling thresholds?
Priya Nair: Q: what does policy v2 change for log retention for Private customers? Any opt-outs?
Tom Becker: can we squeeze in a 3-min ops recap about yesterday's routing table flapping? I have a mini postmortem.
Ivy Wang: LMK if we should surface cost impact numbers for Burst (rough estimate is fine).
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: "Dedicated Burst - Dry Run" starts 11:30am PT in prod-dedicated-1. Rollback window: 30m. Notify #eng-oncall if any alerts.
Nadia Chen: thanks team. Agenda draft:
 - 11:00 Exec updates (Nadia)
 - 11:12 Data Retention Policy v2 (Legal/Trust) + customer impact (5m)
 - 11:20 Dedicated Burst dry-run overview (Product) + demo (5m)
 - 11:30 Ops postmortem: routing flapping (Tom)
 - 11:38 Q&A (live + collected)
Please continue to add Qs. If youre bringing customer notes, DM me.
-- (after meeting) --
Nadia Chen: Slides + recording uploaded: https://redwood.slack.com/files/FGHIJ67890/all-hands-1855004567.mp4
Tom Becker: ops recap: root cause for routing flapping was a mis-sized BGP hold-time param after a config push. Mitigation: reverted, increased hold-time, added monitoring rule. Full postmortem in #postmortems.
Priya Nair: Legal posted the policy doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/privacy/data-retention-v2. Key points: shorter workspace logs by default (90 days), longer retention opt-in for Dedicated/Private with compliance flag.
Omar Ruiz: Product follow-up: Dedicated Burst will start in dry-run mode for 2 weeks; no auto-scaling threshold changes for general customers during dry-run. Canary telemetry will be public in Console under "Experimental": Burst metrics.
Ivy Wang: cost note: expected token-cost delta for bursted workloads ~+3-6% at peak; Product to publish a short FAQ for CS/Finance.
Nadia Chen: Actions captured:
 - Legal: finalize opt-in workflow for extended retention (Priya) by EOD Thu.
 - Product: publish Burst FAQ + telemetry link (Omar) by next Tue.
 - Ops: add BGP hold-time test to deploy checklist (Tom) by next deploy.
Thanks everyone. TL;DR: Data Retention v2 rolling, Dedicated Burst dry-run starts now with telemetry-only exposure, small ops postmortem and clear follow-ups. Post any extra Qs here and we'll add to the FAQ. :memo:
